purpose: LoRA training set to fix SDXL base failure on dried New Mexico chile ristras (parked after 9+ single retries: 710405 geometry winner but red wash, 710503-711017 morphology/branch/color failures). Base SDXL 1.0 cannot render a single vertical strand of 5-7 smooth tapered Capsicum annuum var. annuum pods on a string with top knot — it drifts to piled heaps, ribbed/bitter-melon pods, branched plants, or red fill. LoRA teaches the ristra concept in frontier ink style.

style_lock.render_spec: black ink illustration on a plain white background, frontier ink style, hand-drawn linework with dense crosshatching, stipple dots and fine parallel shading, shapes and counts only, faces left white with one small white highlight gap per piece, single hero ingredient study centered with wide spacing, no plate, no fork, no hand
style_lock.resolution: 1024x1024 square (LoRA training) → inference at 1344x768 (pipeline) via aspect crop; square avoids distortion of vertical strand
style_lock.background: pure white, no shadow, no gradient, no wash
style_lock.ink: pure black ink only, no color, no red/burgundy fill, no yellow wash
style_lock.taxon: Capsicum annuum var. annuum (New Mexico chile — Hatch/Sandia/Chimayo landrace, dried)
style_lock.negative_locked: people, human face, hands, text, signature, watermark, color, green, red, photograph, photorealistic, shading, gradient, solid fill, dark background, drop shadow, 3d render, dense foliage, pile, cluster, overlapping, ribbed, warty, dotted skin, bitter melon, cucumber, okra, flower, leaves, branch, foliage, plant, pinecone, soursop, heap, pile of peppers, scattered, diagonal fan

sourcing.principle: Actual dried New Mexico chile ristras — physical specimens, not synthetic renders. Conditioning bucket = own captures (first-party) + CC0/public-domain only per docs/reference-image-sourcing.md two-bucket control. No consumer-stock (Unsplash/Pexels/Pixabay) in conditioning.
sourcing.capture_plan: Buy 3 real ristras (Hatch, NM): 1x small 5-pod, 1x medium 7-pod, 1x large 10-pod spiral. Hang on white seamless + single north window. Shoot each from 5-6 angles/distances. Supplement with 2 CC0 archival ristra photos (Wikimedia Commons filtered CC0/PD, Smithsonian Open Access) for context variety. Total raw captures ~20, curated to 17 inks.
sourcing.ink_conversion: Each raw photo → hand-traced or manually cleaned B&W ink in frontier style (crosshatch + stipple + parallel lines, white highlight gaps). Do NOT use auto-threshold alone — it preserves ribbing artifacts. Trace smooth tapered sub-cylindrical pods, star calyx attached, fine leather micro-wrinkles (not ribs/dots). Top knot + single vertical string always visible. Export 1024x1024 PNG, 300dpi, pure 1-bit black/white with antialiased edges.

captioning_rules.trigger: Every caption starts with nm-ristra trigger token, then taxon Capsicum annuum var. annuum, then count + geometry (5/7/10 smooth tapered pods, single vertical string, top knot). Always include 'black ink on white, frontier ink style' and deny list terms.
captioning_rules.class_token: dried New Mexico red chile ristra
captioning_rules.keep_counts_exact: Caption counts must match image pod counts exactly — model learns counting from this.
captioning_rules.no_color_words: Never include red, green, or color in any caption — reinforces B&W LoRA.

preprocessing.resolution: 1024x1024, center-cropped, ristra occupies 60-75% of vertical frame, 25-35% horizontal, centered
preprocessing.format: PNG, pure black (0,0,0) ink on pure white (255,255,255) background, no alpha, no EXIF rotation
preprocessing.repeats: Repeat heavier variants (02,05,10) x2 in training to weight canonical and morphology; minimal variants x1
preprocessing.regularization: Add 5 regularization images of generic SDXL frontier ink style without ristra (e.g., existing apples/pumpkins inks) captioned without trigger token, to preserve base style on non-ristra subjects

license_bucket: Own captures = first-party brand tooling, safe for conditioning. CC0 images (ids 14) verified per-item on Wikimedia/Smithsonian rights line. No Unsplash/Pexels/Pixabay in this dataset.
